notes.title: New Dream and Font Changes 3/29
notes.content:
Changelog:
- Changed the square font (used mostly for MicroDreams) to look more like the regular text font
- New Dream: TypeRacer! Race to the end by typing faster than your friends!

notes.title: New MicroDream and Changes 3/25
notes.content:
Changelog:
- Changed wordlist for Word Guess (and Spelling Bee) again to hopefully reduce how often it gives nonsensical words
- Fixed some of the accented letters in trivia so they don't show up as weird symbols or blank spots
- Added leaderboards for Spelling Bee (one for Timed, one for Untimed)
- New MicroDream: Runner! Jump and duck to avoid obstacles!

notes.title: Changes and Fixes 3/24
notes.content:
Changelog:  
- It was already enabled in the last build by mistake but now Town Defender is an actual game (even if not much of one).
- Added Untimed and Endless modes for Spelling Bee
- Added achievements for Spelling Bee (only in Timed and Untimed)
- Extended Timed Spelling Bee timer to 120 seconds

notes.title: New MicroDream and Bug Fixes 3/24
notes.content:
Changelog:  
- Added a new MicroDream: Spelling Bee! Click letters to make words to score points!
- Changed the word list for Word Guess, it now has around 35k words instead of the 2k previously
- Fixed numbers 10 and above not showing up properly in Number Combo 
- Lowered the score required for achievements in Pattern Taps because 20 was way too hard.
- Fixed an obscure bug that was making Lights Out count an untouched puzzle as solved maybe 1 in 20 resets

notes.title: Bug Fixes 3/23
notes.content:
Changelog: 
- Removed the timer from Word Guess because it's hard enough to guess the word without time pressure
- Made the minesweeper achievements earnable with timer off or on (instead of only timer on)
- Fixed an issue in Trivia that was making the achievements not trigger
- Fixed an issue that was making the game freeze up in Number Combo when the round was supposed to end.

notes.title: Achievements + Bug Fixes 3/22
notes.content:
Changelog:
- Changed some background networking code to make way for future multiplayer Dreams
- Made the main directory and the arcade directory prettier
- Made picross grid properly disappear when exiting out of it back to the arcade
- Fixed an issue where singleplayer Trivia score didn't reset after each match
- Fixed an issue where singleplayer Trivia, when played for points, wouldn't end when the target was reached.
- Made it so trivia doesn't repeat questions unless it runs out of unique questions
- Rewrote the code for Number Combo so it hopefully feels a bit better to play.
- Added a letter display to Word Guess to see all known wrong letters easily.
- Added achievements for all the MicroDreams, SimplyTrivia, and Backrooms.

notes.title: Bug Fixes and Feedback Responses 3/21
notes.content:
Bugs Fixed:
- Removed timer from Picross and Number Combo
- Made click-intensive games like Picross larger so they're easier to click
- Made Fruit Catch a little easier
- Fixed double-spawn at start of second+ fruit catch rounds
- Fixed ability to run off edges of map in fruit catch
- Added audio feedback in block break for how many points you gain/lose
- Fixed lights out highlighting only a single line of the buttons
- Fixed Minesweeper text alignment issues
- Fixed space not resetting at end of trivia
- Made arrow keys work for movement in Backrooms
- Made it so that if you ever see the current note/wall in Backrooms, it'll be visible even when not in your current FOV, to make it a little less frustrating to find them.

notes.title: New Dream - Backrooms
notes.content:
Added a new dream to play - Backrooms.

Based on the popular body of internet creepypasta lore, try to escape a seemingly endless series of identical rooms and corridors!

(Also the UI layering bug should be fixed for real now)

notes.title: Minor bug fixes + Documentation
notes.content:
Added documentation for the 5-6 MicroDreams that didn't have any on-screen instructions.
Also hopefully fixed some issues related to window focusing/layering.

notes.title: Complete Rework and Update
notes.content: Completely reworked the game to not be ugly (like the original was), and also to change the scope of the project to encompass more than just a basic trivia game. The trivia game is now just part of the project, alongside the rest of the minigames and features.
